Auto-generated fuzz generators for Solana runtime types and instructions.

# Purpose
This header file defines a large set of `*_generate` functions that build and fill many `fd_*` runtime types with fuzzed data. Each function allocates or advances memory through `alloc_mem`, calls the matching `*_new` constructor, and then writes fields with values from `fd_rng_t` or [`LLVMFuzzerMutate`](<#llvmfuzzermutate>). The file covers many Solana-related data types, such as accounts, vote state, stake state, sysvars, loader instructions, repair protocol messages, transaction errors, and other runtime records.

The file is auto-generated from `fd_types.json`, as noted in the comment at the top. It acts as a support file for fuzz testing and test data creation, not as a normal application entry point. It also defines helper logic for tagged unions and variable-length containers, including discriminant-based `switch` functions and dynamic array or deque setup for nested objects.
